meta.title: refactor: prevent chat messages from re-rendering on stream updates
meta.body_summary: Split streaming message component and memoized assistant/user messages to reduce unnecessary re-renders during chat stream updates.

perf_labels.notes: Small frontend refactor closed quickly by maintainer without any review text or performance evidence; inference highly limited.

core_change_summary.description: Created StreamingMessage component and wrapped AssistantMessage in React.memo to avoid re-renders during stream; removed streamingMessage from useEffect deps in index.tsx; added observer to UserMessage for MobX state changes.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Small refactor touching 4 files in ChatMessages directory.
